fake_effect_policy: pooled regularized logistic model; fake-punt and fake-FG indicators borrow strength from normal designed-run/dropback plays
run_pass_policy: run and dropback share one model using is_pass
broken_execution_policy: broken fake executions remain in conversion training outcomes but execution_status is never used as a pre-play predictor
transition_policy: sample conversion first; then borrow run/dropback transition behavior conditional on play style and conversion outcome; use empirical fake rare pool for rare special-teams execution outcomes
